# Beaver & Bulldog

> Sports pub and wingery in Collingwood, Ontario — famous for fresh jumbo buffalo wings (27 flavours), local and imported beers, big-screen sports, patio dining, and takeout. A favourite stop for guests from The Blue Mountains, Wasaga Beach, Thornbury, Stayner, Clearview and South Georgian Bay.

## About

Beaver & Bulldog Sports Pub & Wingery is an innovative Collingwood pub owned by Brandon Biggs. The kitchen is known for world-famous fresh jumbo buffalo wings (27 flavours, 100% trans fat free oil), fresh fish, Canadian beef, and local market selections. Guests also come for about 35 local and imported beers, big TVs for live sports, and a patio in warmer weather. Southern Georgian Bay Readers’ Choice 2019 Winner. Google rating about 4.4 based on roughly 1,450+ reviews.

## Signature dishes & specials

- Fresh jumbo buffalo wings — 27 flavours; Flavour of the Month rotates
- Tuesday Wing Day — jumbo wings $1.45 eat-in only with beverage purchase (no takeout on this special)
- Friday — Fresh Catch of the Day
- Sunday — Caesar Sunday ($6 single shot)
- Bulldog burgers, pub sandwiches, pastas, entrées, appetizers, salads
- Kids menu for ages 12 and under

## Live sports on TV

Sports pub with plenty of televisions for live hockey (including Toronto Maple Leafs / NHL), NFL football, basketball, baseball, soccer, golf, UFC and major events such as the Super Bowl and Stanley Cup playoffs when available. Call 705-446-9711 to confirm coverage of a particular game or special event. Good spot for groups watching sports; larger groups and birthday / team gatherings should call ahead.

## Visit & takeout

Walk-ins welcome. Peak dinner hours (about 5–7:30pm) can be busy. Call 705-446-9711 for takeout or large groups. Summer patio is dog-friendly. Dedicated guest parking on site. Wheelchair accessible.
